description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Lavabrink Floodgates and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.
